shared_envelope.organizationId: The existing cooperative target, resolved and ownership-checked from PostgreSQL inside the tenant transaction.
shared_envelope.actor_tenant: Authenticated actor and tenant come from the persisted session; request-supplied authority claims are rejected by strict schemas.
shared_envelope.receipt: The shared WP1 receipt binds tenant, command ID, actor, command type/schema, canonical payload and expected version. Exact command replay returns that receipt without reevaluating authority or mutating state.
shared_envelope.atomicity: Source mutation, aggregate state, immutable domain event, outbox, D-16 changed-scope versions and receipt commit or roll back in one WP1 command transaction. Successful semantic no-op operations persist a safe receipt but no source mutation, event, outbox message or D-16 increment.

GrantCapacity.delegate_source: sourceRef is required for delegate and is stored as documentary provenance. Generic commands reject acting_officer.
GrantCapacity.interval: activeFrom < activeTo and activeTo > database transaction time; effective interval is [activeFrom, activeTo).
GrantCapacity.actor_authority: Active Chairperson/Vice-Chairperson appointment or active, source-backed acting appointment for those offices in this cooperative; platform_enroller may grant only internal_verifier when the exact open session is tenant/cooperative/enroller-bound and has typed presence, NRC-sighted and consent-to-act attestations; the command records approve_internal_verifier for that session's representative.

RevokeCapacity.target: Resolve the exact existing capacity grant by ID; never revoke by broad user/capacity lookup.
RevokeCapacity.actor_authority: Active Chairperson/Vice-Chairperson appointment or active, source-backed acting appointment for those offices in this cooperative.

DelegateTaScope.grant.target: Outer organizationId and the persisted target_organization_id identify one existing eligible cooperative. No cohort or implied group membership.
persisted_checks: actor has active persisted ta_delegation scope over target cooperative
union is a same-tenant union or federation
delegatee has active union_ta institutional assignment with that union
DelegateTaScope.grant.agreement: Persist agreementRef as documentary reference only; no agreement register exists, so legal validity is not asserted.
DelegateTaScope.grant.interval: activeFrom < activeTo and activeTo > database transaction time; effective interval is [activeFrom, activeTo).

DelegateTaScope.revoke.target: Resolve and revoke exactly one persisted delegation ID; verify its cooperative target is the outer organizationId and manager retains active persisted scope over that target.
DelegateTaScope.revoke.actor_authority: Active programme_manager role and persisted ta_delegation scope for that cooperative.

lifecycle.same_command_id: WP1 semantic replay; return original stored result without reauthorization, source mutation, event, or scope version increment.
lifecycle.identical_active_grant: Successful semantic no-op receipt; no new source row, event, outbox, or D-16 version increment. Capacity identity compares tenant, grantee, cooperative, capacity type, effective interval and source reference. TA identity compares tenant, union, delegatee, cooperative, agreement reference and effective interval; the granting manager is provenance, not part of the semantic identity. An exact future interval repeat is also a no-op to avoid duplicate scheduled sources.
lifecycle.conflicting_active_grant: Deterministic conflict; never silently return a grant with different source, agreement, or interval as identical.
lifecycle.repeated_revoke: Successful semantic no-op receipt only for the same already-revoked source row; no new event or version increment.
lifecycle.grant_after_expiry_or_revocation: Create a new immutable source row and event, then increment each changed D-16 scope exactly once.
lifecycle.target_denial: Missing and cross-tenant target map to the same generic NOT_AUTHORIZED denial; no business receipt or mutation.
lifecycle.timestamps: Database transaction time records granted/revoked timestamps; effective times are explicit payload values.

events.payload: Tenant-bound source ID, actor, grantee/delegatee, target organization, capacity or union, effective times, and documentary provenance; no client authority claims.
events.revocation: Append-only event and revoked timestamp; never rewrite historical findings or prior events.

projection_and_locks.capacity_table: symphony.capacity_grants with active_from, expires_at, source_ref, source_event_id and revoked_event_id; only registered command writers receive scoped DML. Insert starts with a null source_event_id; the same transaction binds the immutable event after repository persistence to satisfy tenant RLS.
projection_and_locks.ta_table: symphony.ta_scope_delegations with active_from, expires_at, agreement_ref, source_event_id and revoked_event_id; direct cooperative target. Event references are bound after event persistence within the same transaction.
projection_and_locks.scope_set: Capacity changes lock target organization, tenant, actor_tenant for grantor and grantee, plus fixed D-16 global/actor dependencies required by the inventory. TA changes lock target cooperative, union/federation, tenant, actor_tenant for manager and delegatee, plus required fixed D-16 dependencies.
projection_and_locks.order: Command target aggregate first, then canonical D-16 ordered scope set via WP2.6. Resolve immutable source identity before authority locks only under the command-target lock; read mutable authority/source state only after all authority locks are acquired.
projection_and_locks.increments: Increment exactly the changed mutable scopes once with the source write. No-op, conflict and denial increment none.

known_limitations: Agreement references are documentary text and are not verified against a registry.

No dedicated acting-officer appointment/delegation mutation model is included; generic capacity commands cannot create acting_officer. Acting authority remains usable only when the trusted context supplies a valid source-backed record.
The current PostgreSQL command policy store fails closed for source-backed acting-officer actors because it cannot resolve a typed acting appointment/delegation from existing persisted records.

The assisted-enrolment session fact source is frozen for runtime writes; session-start and attestation production workflow is outside WP2.3. The registered GrantCapacity command records the representative's approval atomically with the IFV grant.
WP2.4 still owns PostgreSQL two-order race/barrier evidence after WP2.3 source mutation exists.
implementation_gate: Owner contract is resolved by D-19. Implementation and exact-candidate WP2.3 gate evidence remain pending.
